name: manhar-nexus
description: Manhar Nexus — modular business operations platform (Core + Modules + Configuration)

scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @nexus/shared && npm run prisma:generate -w @nexus/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nexus/shared && npm run build -w @nexus/api && npm run build -w @nexus/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @nexus/shared && npm run typecheck -w @nexus/api && npm run typecheck -w @nexus/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @nexus/api && npm run test -w @nexus/web
